- Requirement: PR description and the `substitution_bodies` docstring require the new scanner to read the raw command "the way Bash does" — specifically that `$(...)` inside double quotes counts as a hidden call when its body holds `gh api`, matching how Bash itself would expand it. CLAUDE.md §23.H is updated to the same wording, so the prose the guard is documented to satisfy is the same Bash-faithful one.
  Expected change site: .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py (and the workflow-templates/ twin), `substitution_bodies()` `$(...)` branch at lines ~385-397.   Evidence of absence: The inner loop has only `\\`, `(`, and `)` branches — no quote-state tracking. The 9 parametrized cases added in `tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py:584-594` cover `echo \`a\`` (escaped backtick) and balanced nested parens (`"$(a (b) c)"`), but no case places a `)` or `(` inside a `"..."` or `'...'` span within `$(...)`. The 5 new ASK cases (lines 239-243) and 5 new no-decision cases (lines 277-281) also do not exercise this shape. Both `consensus findings` and `consensus task gaps` from the cross-pollination pass identify exactly this gap; the implementation has not been delivered.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
